'''Sticky explosives''' were adhesive [[Bomb/Legends|demolitions]] that were used by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] when he fought the [[Kage Warriors/Legends|Kage Warriors]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]]. Once these devices were attached to the target, Dengar would detonate them.
